name: irq: interrupts arrive on -I 16 (logged once)
shell: /tmp/t_xfer soak:30:0x48:00:2 >/dev/null; slog2info -b i2c_ichsmb | grep -E 'first interrupt|no interrupt after' | tail -1

name: irq: a wrong interrupt number is reported (PCI server's 10)
shell: /tmp/t_xfer soak:30:0x48:00:2 >/dev/null; slog2info -b i2c_ichsmb | grep -E 'first interrupt|no interrupt after' | tail -1
expect: .*i2c-ichsmb: no interrupt after 20 transactions: interrupt 10 is probably not this controller's.*

name: irq: transfers still work when the interrupt never comes
irq: driver logs to slog2 buffer i2c_ichsmb
shell: slog2info -b i2c_ichsmb | grep 'ICH9 SMBus at' | tail -1
expect: .*i2c-ichsmb: ICH9 SMBus at 0:1f\.3, I/O 0x700, interrupt 16 \(-I\), status 0x00
